capabilities: Search notes with AND, phrase, tag and exclusion queries
Rank results by open-count and recency frecency
Restore a persistent index and re-index only changed notes in the background
Tune field weights, recency weight and edit boost in settings
Show image thumbnails and per-result score breakdowns
extras: No marketplace one-click install documented; README describes building from source and copying dist files into the plugins folder, with install and release scripts for development.
intentEvidence: It started as a rethink of Omnisearch: a familiar search modal with a smaller memory footprint
motivation: The author wanted a faster, leaner search with a smaller memory footprint and ranking that favors the notes actually used, which existing search did not provide.
problem: Obsidian's core search doesn't strongly surface recently and frequently opened notes and can be heavy on memory and indexing time in large vaults.

relations.evidence: It started as a rethink of Omnisearch: a familiar search modal with a smaller memory footprint

summary: Search modal for the vault with precise prefix, phrase, tag and negation queries, ranked by open-based frecency over a lightweight persistent index.
